corrected_text: On Apple GPUs with Metal, ML Drift's FullyConnected kernel (fully_connected.cc:96-140) splits the reduction over input slices across 1 to 128 threads in y, in work groups of 256 threads on GPUs with at least 16 compute units and 128 otherwise. The split is chosen from the task size per compute unit: output slices, times the batch count for batched-weight FCs, with the thresholds scaled by 16/bits for weights of 8 bits or fewer; at 16384 or more output slices y is 1. MoE packed-group FCs and FCs whose caller passes a work-group size use a fixed group instead.
note: Spot audit after Run A (2026-10-15): sizing quantity is output slices times batch count for batched-weight FCs (fully_connected.cc:102-108), thresholds scaled by 16/bits for <=8-bit weights (112-114), y forced to 1 at >=16384 slices (134-136), MoE packed-group FCs use fixed (64,1,1) (1023).
